notes.title: Get ready for MUNFU! Mobocratic Union Next Fest Update (Beta 0.85) is out
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Experience unique and personalized avatars with our newly designed hand-drawn graphics. Our procedural, paper-doll-like system generates a vast variety of avatars for both players and NPCs.
[*] Get a revamped organization view that visualizes the different factors impacting your organization's effectiveness. Now, easily grasp the bars that represent these factors.
[*] Stay updated with the latest committee view enhancements. Discover the exact person who proposed a new amendment, along with their party affiliation.
[*] Enjoy the fresh graphics available in the Steam library.
[*] We value your feedback! Introducing a new feedback button that supplements the already existing feedback quiz upon exiting the game.
[*] Explore the updated Mobopedia, brimming with new articles for getting you started in the game.
[*] The latest two updates change the visuals of the game and if you have played a prior version of the game we heavily recommend you test out the latest version! We believe much progress has been made and the game is clearly improving
[/list]

notes.title: Mobocratic Union January Update (Beta 0.84)
notes.content:
Happy new year to all our fellow mobocrats!

Today, we're glad to announce the newest the Mobocratic Union January Update, which includes many new, intriguing new features. Let's take a look, shall we?

[list]
[*] New background graphics for the MEPs office, news studio and country page
[*] UI improvements: verbalized and visualized ideological descriptions of policy proposals and visualization of relative influence between characters
[*] Inbuilt Mobopedia with articles on how to play the game and explanations on how the different systems in the game work
[*] Some easter eggs... As Aristotle said: "Those who know, know." Others, let's figure out!
[*] A system for activating and inactivating amendments based on thematic amendment packs
[*] Several bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Mobocratic Union Mid-December Update (Beta 0.82)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Adding amendments to proposals now costs Prestige Points, therefore increasing the importance of good staff planning skills!
[*] The Council of European Union now sends back counter-proposals to the European Parliament, if it does not approve the original proposals
[*] Other improvements, including small UI improvements and bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Mobocratic Union December Mini-Update (Beta 0.81) Is Here!
notes.content:
Greetings political gaming enthusiasts! It has been a mere month since our last update, and today, we proudly present to you the December edition of Mobocratic Union. Prepare yourselves for an electrifying array of enhancements that will undoubtedly amplify your political prowess:
[list]
[*] Behold the improvements bestowed upon the character screen user interface, making it easier to focus on the relevant information and being more economical with screen real estate
[*] Immerse yourself in the captivating visual panorama of character avatars, as we unleash an arsenal of over 100 brand-new graphic files. Witness your beloved virtual politicians come to life in breathtaking detail
[*] Fear not, for we have eradicated a pesky bug that once plagued the national seat distribution grap
[*] As the tumultuous moment arrives, indulge your senses in the exquisite symphony of sound effects now harmoniously synchronized with the pivotal voting events. Be transported into the very heart of democracy, where each decision reverberates with palpable consequence.
[/list]
We are confident that these refinements elevate your Mobocratic Union experience to new heights. 
Rest assured, dear enthusiasts, for this is but a taste of the bountiful updates that await you in the ever-unfolding future.

notes.title: Mobocratic Union November Update (Beta 0.8)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added the ability to choose a gender in the politician creator view.
[*] Improved the country view by displaying political party support with a bar chart and showing the graphical distribution of elected seats by their party holders.
[*] Added 17 new amendments with themes related to immigration, constitutional rights, and agriculture.
[*] Added 25 new amendments focusing on criminal justice reform and national defense.
[*] Alphabetically arranged the EU member countries list in the character generation menu.
[*] Added more descriptive country descriptions in the upper right corner of the country overview section.
[*] Introduced 30 Finnish language male first names and 30 female first names.
[*] Rewrote one of the start questionnaire questions to ensure that the alternatives fit into symmetrical and appealing buttons.
[*] Improved dialogue in the team management system.
[/list]
